prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, sculpted updo jet-black hair — wearing a skin-tight micro retro gym set, a cropped short-sleeve gym top of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with a navy collar band and two navy stripes on each sleeve edge, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and micro gathered bloomers of ultra-thin matte navy modal jersey with elastic gathered leg openings cut high up to the very top of her hip bones, sitting at the top of her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the navy collar band, the sleeve stripes and the gathered edges of the bloomers against the white, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, her left hand resting on her hip and her right arm relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in white lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed far beyond the extreme, every element exaggerated to the maximum: a thick opaque white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line over the whole lid and up past the brows to the temples, a wide thick white band painted under both eyes, enormous bright turquoise liner wings flaring far beyond the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes in double layers top and bottom, thick opaque glossy white lips with a sharp outline.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows medium body oil, moderate skin glistening, healthy oiled appearance.

Background: a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
